watches.name: FALCON
watches.description: The Falcon is our field watch—or better yet, our sporty, elegant all-rounder. The 36mm case represents, in our view, the ideal size for a watch with a fixed bezel; any larger begins to feel too casual, even on bigger wrists. We wanted it to be versatile without being plain, so we kept the classic 3-6-9 dial layout while introducing a bit more dynamism, faceted the polished broad-arrow hands, and topped it with a sapphire crystal. Powered by a reliable Miyota 9039 automatic movement and housed in a 100-meter water-resistant stainless steel case, the Falcon is ready to go anywhere—land, sea, air, or even space. It’s a watch built for everyday wear, but never short on character.

watches.name: HYPERION
watches.description: The Hyperion is our platonic ideal of the GMT archetype. With its case measuring a classic 39mm (37mm at the bezel), it makes for a versatile and refined travel companion. We made it for those who prefer to fly in style, giving it details like gilt accents on a glossy black dial, paired with mature tones of red and blue. It's supremely practical as well, featuring a sapphire crystal and bidirectional 24-click sapphire bezel, a Miyota 9075 movement with an independently adjustable hour hand (commonly called a "true" or "flyer's" GMT), and 100 meters of water resistance.

watches.name: ASTRA
watches.description: The Astra is our idea of an elevated daily—that is, something you'd wear every day because you believe every day can be a little more elegant. It has a classic 36mm case, for those with an equally classic sense of style. That said, it still has the specs of a tool watch, with 100 meters of water resistance, a trusted Miyota 9039 automatic movement, and a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal.

watches.name: NEPTUNE
watches.description: The Neptune is our interpretation of a dive watch from the golden era of dive watches. With its classic styling and sleek 39mm case (37mm at the bezel), it feels just as at home on your wrist in a wetsuit as it does with a dinner jacket. It now features a sapphire crystal and bezel, making scratches far less of a concern. Of course, the case offers 200 meters of water resistance and houses a robust Miyota 9039 automatic movement.
